result.instructions: Tools for Tick, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How many hours did the team log on the Acme project this month?"; "List my open projects and their budgets."; "Show all the time entries my team logged last week.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Tick data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run tick_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run tick_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run tick_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. tick_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: tick_list_clients
tools.title: List clients
tools.description: List Tick clients. By default only clients that have open projects; set include_all=true for every client (also archived or without projects). 100 per page. GET /clients.json or /clients/all.json.

include_all.description: true = all clients, false/omitted = only clients with open projects.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1; 100 records per page). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: tick_get_client
tools.title: Get client
tools.description: One client by id, with a summary of its projects (count and URL). GET /clients/{id}.json.

tools.name: tick_list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List Tick projects with budget (hours or money), billable flag, client_id and owner_id. Open projects by default; status=closed for closed ones. 100 per page. GET /projects.json or /projects/closed.json.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1; 100 records per page). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: tick_get_project
tools.title: Get project
tools.description: One project by id, with total_hours entered, a summary of its tasks (count and URL) and its client. GET /projects/{id}.json.

tools.name: tick_list_tasks
tools.title: List tasks
tools.description: List Tick tasks (the budget lines that time entries are logged against). Across all projects, or for one project when project_id is given. Open tasks by default; status=closed for closed ones. You need a task id to log time. 100 per page. GET /tasks.json, /tasks/closed.json, /projects/{id}/tasks.json or /projects/{id}/tasks/closed.json.

project_id.description: Only the tasks of this project.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1; 100 records per page). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: tick_get_task
tools.title: Get task
tools.description: One task by id, with total_hours entered, a summary of its entries (count and URL) and its project. GET /tasks/{id}.json.

tools.name: tick_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List the users of the Tick subscription (id, name, e-mail, timezone). A non-administrator sees only themself. Use deleted=true for removed users who still have time entries (administrators only). GET /users.json or /users/deleted.json.

deleted.description: true = deleted users that have time entries.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1; 100 records per page). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: tick_list_entries
tools.title: List time entries
tools.description: List time entries. Tick requires EITHER start_date AND end_date (entries dated in that range) OR updated_at (entries created or changed after that time). Optional filters: project_id, task_id, user_id, billable, billed. Each entry has date, hours, notes, task_id, user_id. 100 per page. GET /entries.json.

start_date.description: First day of the range (with end_date).

end_date.description: Last day of the range (with start_date).

updated_at.description: Only entries created or modified after this time (instead of a date range).

billed.description: Only billed (true) or not yet billed (false) entries.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1; 100 records per page). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: tick_get_entry
tools.title: Get time entry
tools.description: One time entry by id, with its task. GET /entries/{id}.json.

tools.name: tick_create_entry
tools.title: Log time entry
tools.description: WRITE: log a new time entry on a task (POST /entries.json). Needs the task id (see tick_list_tasks). hours is a decimal (1.5 = 1h30m). user_id is only honored for administrators (otherwise the entry is yours). Creates a new entry every call; nothing is sent to anyone.

task_id.description: Task to log the time on.

date.description: Day the work was done, yyyy-mm-dd.

hours.description: Hours worked, decimal (1.5 = one and a half hours).

user_id.description: Administrators only: log the time for this user.

tools.name: tick_update_entry
tools.title: Update time entry
tools.description: WRITE: change an existing time entry (PUT /entries/{id}.json): hours, notes, date, task, or mark it billed. Only the fields you pass change; the previous values are overwritten.

task_id.description: Move the entry to this task.

billed.description: Mark the entry as billed / not billed.

tools.name: tick_create_client
tools.title: Create client
tools.description: WRITE: create a new client (POST /clients.json). Tick administrators only (403 otherwise). Creates a new client every call.

tools.name: tick_create_project
tools.title: Create project
tools.description: WRITE: create a new project (POST /projects.json). Tick administrators only. The project has no tasks: create at least one with tick_create_task before time can be logged. Creates a new project every call.

client_id.description: Client the project belongs to (see tick_list_clients).

budget.description: Project budget (hours, or money for a money-based subscription).

owner_id.description: User id of the project owner.

tools.name: tick_create_task
tools.title: Create task
tools.description: WRITE: create a new task on a project (POST /tasks.json). Tick administrators only. Creates a new task every call.

prompts.title: Get started with Tick
prompts.description: What you can do with Tick here, with example requests to try.
